verdict.rationale: Postman's docs are exposed in AI-consumable formats (llms.txt, per-page .md, openapi.json) and its CLI can actually execute example collections headlessly, giving an AI-native user a way to both read and run API examples. However, there is no evidence of a purpose-built 'interactive API reference' UI with embedded runnable examples (e.g., try-it widgets) as distinct from generic collection docs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an interactive documentation surface with inline runnable examples, and independent confirmation beyond first-party probes.
